guides.vulnerability_name: Windows DNS Server Remote Code Execution
guides.treatment_action:
Recommended treatment actions:  
- Implement and enforce multi-factor authentication for all remote access to SRV-01 and SRV-03  
- Apply the latest security patches to address CVE-2020-1350 and CVE-2021-31166 on affected hosts  
- Configure firewall rules to restrict remote access to SRV-01 and SRV-03 to only necessary IP ranges and ports  
- Conduct regular vulnerability scans and penetration tests to identify and remediate unpatched systems

- Apply security patches and updates for all identified vulnerabilities (CVE-2020-1472, CVE-2020-1350, CVE-2017-0144, CVE-2021-44228, CVE-2021-31166) on affected hosts.  
- Disable or configure WinRM and SMB services to restrict remote command execution exposure on SRV-03 and SRV-04.  
- Implement network segmentation to isolate Domain Controllers, DNS Servers, File Servers, and Application Servers based on their roles.  
- Conduct regular vulnerability scans and configure automated patch management to ensure ongoing compliance with network services security requirements.
